notes.title: A new root will be added when the number of buyers exceeds a thousand!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259395/e938c0fa9dc34454cc3f83e29538d79fa8bfc03d.png[/img]
A new root [UNWELCOME BEACH] will be added when the number of buyers for the Butuber Paranoia Steam edition exceeds a thousand!

Please show a lot of interest and purchase until midnight on the 15th!

GAME : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292190/___Vtuber_Paranoia

ARTBOOK DLC : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316420/___Vtuber_Paranoia/

UNWELCOME BEACH~Synopsis

One day, while continuing an ordinary broadcast, Hiyoru received a suspicious game key from a viewer.
Hiyoro, who turned on the game with the thought that it wouldn't be a big deal, soon lost his mind,
When I open my eyes, I find myself trapped by a beach I've never seen before...?



* Please be informed that the steam version is only applicable, and the refund is excluded from the count
* In the case of adding a new route, we would like to inform you that the same update will be carried out in the stove-indi version
